documents.title: Rate exhibit
documents.text: The CSV contains disjoint annual Personal Auto rating segments. Rates equal base rate times combined factor.

documents.title: Premium basis
documents.text: Exposures are annual vehicle-years. Current premium is exposures times current modeled annual rate. Portfolio composition, coverage and limits are held fixed. Taxes, fees and policy rounding are excluded.

documents.title: Internal approval note
documents.text: No regulatory approval is claimed. A human analyst must verify any applicable requirement using authoritative sources.
